findings.title: Required formatRate export is absent
findings.body: The requirements mandate an exported `formatRate(fraction)`, but the module still exports only `parseRate`. Consumers receive `undefined` and crash with a `TypeError` when calling the required API.
findings.recommendation: Implement `formatRate` and add it to `module.exports`; add tests for `formatRate(0.25) === "25%"` and the new percent parsing cases.

next_steps: Implement and test the missing `formatRate` API before shipping.
